summary: Backend regression after moving /api/health BEFORE app.include_router(api). All 9 targeted tests pass (health P0 + root + auth + protected 401 + products + wallet + admin/shpay/health + admin/deposits + admin route auth guard).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is very large (>3500 lines); the earlier bug (route registered after include_router) is a direct symptom of file size — consider splitting into routers/modules.
Root Dockerfile copies backend/ but ensure .dockerignore isn't excluding backend/.env inadvertently; Fly.io should source config via fly.io secrets, verify at deploy time.
Consider adding a startup assertion in server.py that logs the mounted routes count so silent-drop bugs are caught in CI.

context_for_next_testing_agent: P0 /api/health fix verified. Reusable regression suite at /app/backend/tests/test_health_regression.py covers health, auth, admin, wallet, products, and 401 guards. Products endpoint resolved at /api/products; wallet resolved via /api/auth/me (has numeric wallet_balance).
rca of the issue: Original 404 root cause: @api.get('/health') was declared after app.include_router(api) — FastAPI's APIRouter registration copies routes at include time, so any routes added after are silently ignored. Fix (move health route before include_router) confirmed working: GET /api/health returns 200 with {status:'ok', service:'naijainvest-api', time:<iso>}.
